# Phase 23 golden texts: where each sentence comes from

Plan 23-03 (CONTEXT D-14, 23-NOTES sections 1 and 3). The `.txt` files under `alerts/` are
GENERATED by `scripts/gen_phase23_fixtures.py` from `src/ops/alert_wording.py`; do not edit them
by hand and do not hand-type new ones. This file is documentation: it names, for every worded
entry, the emitting source that makes each of the four sentences true. Line numbers are those of
the tree read on 2026-10-25 (the code at the plan 23-03 commit); if the code moves, read it again.

Reading rule: a sentence claims only what the emitting code does. Where the emitters of one
event differ (DB_FAILURE), the sentence is the one that is true for all of them and every emitter
is listed. The Phase 20 header (severity, event, subject, reason, UTC time) is
`render_alert_text` and is not reworded. Alerts reach the operator as text only; nothing here
places, cancels or re-sends an order (Q5, D080).

Fixed inputs of the generator: occurred_at_utc 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z, subject `plan-0001` for the
producers that know the plan and `SYSTEM` for the three SAFE_MODE observer events, symbol
`BTCUSDT`. The reason of a golden file is a representative one (for TP_UNAVAILABLE the reason
is the producer's reason code since D113, for EMERGENCY_CLOSE_FAILED the failure code, see the
rows).

## What every CLOSE_REQUIRED entry says about the system (shared sentence)

"The plan moved to CLOSE_REQUIRED, new entries are blocked (SAFE_MODE CLOSE_REQUIRED) and a
reduce-only MARKET emergency close was attempted; if that close fails, EMERGENCY_CLOSE_FAILED or
EMERGENCY_CLOSE_NOT_SENT follows as its own alert."

- `src/execution/protection.py` 2597-2636 (`_enter_close_required`): the in-memory state flips to
  CLOSE_REQUIRED first (`blocks_new_entries()` is true from then on), then `_attempt_close` calls
  the emergency closer; the stop is "never cancelled here ... and never resent".
- `src/execution/protection.py` 2638-2665 (`_record_close_required`): after the close attempt,
  "whether the close succeeded, failed or raised", SAFE_MODE(`CLOSE_REQUIRED`) is entered and the
  critical alert `CLOSE_REQUIRED` is sent with `reason=branch`.
- `src/execution/emergency_close.py` 923-957 (`_fail`) and 973-1010 (`_not_sent`): the two
  alerts a failed close raises.
- `src/execution/protection.py` 75-80 (module docstring): "SAFE_MODE(CLOSE_REQUIRED), a critical
  alert CLOSE_REQUIRED, the branch code journaled on the transition, then close_position".
- "An open stop is kept until the position is flat; the stop is never cancelled here" (B1, B6,
  OPERATOR_CLOSE): `protection.py` 2604-2606, 1103-1105 and the docstring 28-31.

## RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED (wording only, not an alert event)

`reconciliation_required_text()` is for the DEMO/LIVE card and its replies (plans 23-11 and
23-12). `RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED` is a refusal reason of `ExecutionOutcome`
(`RejectionReason.RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED`, `manager.py` 1633-1637); it is not in `ALERT_EVENTS`.
It is returned for an unreadable or unwritable store (1278-1292, 1296-1301), for an entry left
UNKNOWN (1363) and for a failed hand-off (1430), and it is the answer of the SAFE_MODE guard
(`manager.py` 587). The wording therefore says only what is true for all of them: the result is
not settled, it needs reconciliation, nothing was re-sent (Q5, D080) and the operator checks the
exchange. It never says "rejected" (T-23-09).

## Words that are deliberately absent

- "rejected" for an ambiguous entry (ENTRY_STATE_UNKNOWN, RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED): an ambiguous
  result is "needs reconciliation". Only `B5_STOP_REJECTED` (a definitive exchange rejection of a
  stop) and the code names carry the word.
- "safe", "protected" or "closed" as a claim: no entry says the position is safe; a failed or
  refused close is stated as such.
- Any number, price, quantity, id, secret, mention or URL: the table is static and a test refuses
  the characters used for them.

## Messages (plan 23-09)

Golden texts under `messages/` are produced by `_messages_section()` of
`scripts/gen_phase23_fixtures.py`, never typed. The inputs are the plan 23-02 LONG fixture
(`tests/test_money_at_stake.py`): entry 50100 (adverse edge of the entry zone 50000-50100), stop
49500, take-profits 51000 and 52000 with fractions 0.5 and 0.5, quantity 0.08, leverage 5, equity
800 USDT read at 2026-10-09 03:00:00 UTC (10:00:00 +07), fee 0.0005 and slippage 0.0002 per side (0.0007 per leg
and price). The message layer formats the stored values only (`format(value, "f")`); the figures
below are the independent derivation of what the risk layer stored.

| Line | Derivation from the fixture inputs |
|---|---|
| `Notional: 4008.00 USDT` | quantity x entry = 0.08 x 50100 = 4008.00 |
| `Margin: 801.60 USDT at 5x leverage (...)` | notional / leverage = 4008.00 / 5 = 801.60, truncated toward zero at 18 digits (exact here); the leverage source label is the plan constraint snapshot |
| `Loss at SL: 48.00 USDT gross, 53.5776 USDT net` | gross = 0.08 x (50100 - 49500) = 48.00; net = the sizing result's `realized_risk` = 0.08 x (600 + (50100 + 49500) x 0.0007) = 0.08 x 669.72 = 53.5776 |
| `Profit at TP1 (0.5 of quantity): 36.000 gross, 33.1692000 net` | leg 0.08 x 0.5 = 0.040; gross = 0.040 x (51000 - 50100) = 36.000; cost = 0.040 x (50100 + 51000) x 0.0007 = 2.8308000; net = 36.000 - 2.8308000 = 33.1692000 |
| `Profit at TP2 (0.5 of quantity): 76.000 gross, 73.1412000 net` | leg 0.040; gross = 0.040 x (52000 - 50100) = 76.000; cost = 0.040 x (50100 + 52000) x 0.0007 = 2.8588000; net = 76.000 - 2.8588000 = 73.1412000 |
| `Equity used: 800 USDT (ACCOUNT_LIVE:..., observed 2026-10-09 10:00:00 +07 (2026-10-09 03:00:00 UTC))` | the equity reading is an input (800), with its source label and observation time, shown as local +07 with UTC in brackets |
| `Detected:` / `Expiry:` | 2026-10-09 03:00:00 UTC and detected + 4 hours = 2026-10-09 07:00:00 UTC, shown by `format_presentation_time` as `2026-10-09 10:00:00 +07 (2026-10-09 03:00:00 UTC)` and `2026-10-09 14:00:00 +07 (2026-10-09 07:00:00 UTC)` (UTC + 7 hours, no daylight saving) |

Trailing zeros in the figures (`36.000`, `33.1692000`) are the exponent the stored Decimal keeps;
the renderer writes every digit and never rounds (D-13).

Files: `approve_base.txt` (`format_approve`: no mode line, no money, times local +07 with UTC in brackets),
`approve_request_demo.txt` and `approve_request_live.txt` (`format_approval_request`, `Mode:
DEMO` / `Mode: LIVE`), `simulate.txt` (`format_simulate`: the same quantity line and money block as the request,
times local +07 with UTC in brackets, no mode line; a payload without money is a FAILED outcome with zero attempts). None names
Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh: since the owner's answer to O-3 (2026-10-30) D-14 shows these messages as the
local `+07` time with UTC in brackets, which satisfies docs/DECISIONS.md D025 (D025 is not edited).
SHADOW texts keep their UTC + Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh pairs.

## Confirm card (plan 23-12)

Golden texts `messages/confirm_card_demo.txt`, `confirm_final_confirmed_demo.txt` and
`confirm_final_expired_demo.txt` are produced by `_confirm_section()` of
`scripts/gen_phase23_fixtures.py` through `format_live_confirm_card` and `format_live_confirm_final`
(`src/adapters/telegram_notify.py`), never typed. They are the text of the DEMO flow of
`src/execution/confirm_flow.py` for the plan 23-02 LONG fixture (see "Messages" above for its
inputs). Fixed inputs: the card is issued at 2026-10-09 03:00:00 UTC, the mark price is 50050, the
owner minimum of remaining validity is 600 s (a test value, not a ratified limit), the clock margin
is 2 s, the confirm window is 60 s. The card renderer does no money arithmetic: every amount is the
stored `MoneyAtStake` value written with `format(value, "f")`.

| Line | Source |
|---|---|
| `CONFIRM BTCUSDT LONG` / `Mode: DEMO` | the signal symbol and direction; the mode of the flow profile (DEMO or LIVE only) |
| `Quantity: 0.08` | stored `money.quantity` (the plan's `quantity_after_rounding`, equal by `require_money_consistent` at issue) |
| `Notional: 4008.00 USDT` | stored `money.notional` = 0.08 x 50100 (see Messages) |
| `Loss at SL: 48.00 USDT gross, 53.5776 USDT net of modeled costs` | stored `money.loss_at_stop_gross` and `money.loss_at_stop_net` (see Messages) |
| `Mark price: 50050 (entry 50100, SL 49500)` | the mark input (a fixed 50050 here; in the flow the injected `mark_price(symbol)` read at issue); entry and SL are the stored `money.entry_price` and `money.stop_loss_price`. A missing mark reads `unavailable`, never a number |
| `Remaining validity: 14400 s to the plan expiry 2026-10-09 14:00:00 +07 (2026-10-09 07:00:00 UTC); placement check: passes` | seconds = plan expiry 07:00:00 - issue time 03:00:00 = 4 h = 14400 s. The verdict is the code returned by the injected validity rule, here `check_remaining_validity` (`src/execution/pre_placement.py`): the remaining time to the floored `goodTillDate` second must exceed the owner minimum (600) and `GTD_MIN_AHEAD_SECONDS` (600) plus the margin (2 s); 14400 s does, so no code is returned and the card says `passes`. With a code it reads `refused (<CODE>)`: `LIMITS_NOT_CONFIGURED` when the owner minimum is None (the card never prints a minimum it was not given), `VALIDITY_TOO_SHORT` when the time is not enough |
| `Confirm until 2026-10-09 10:01:00 +07 (2026-10-09 03:01:00 UTC) (60 s window)` | issue time + the confirm window of D041 (60 s) |
| `CONFIRMED by user 777001 at 2026-10-09 10:00:30 +07 (2026-10-09 03:00:30 UTC)` | the approving user id bound at APPROVE and the stored CONFIRM instant (30 s after issue) |
| `Placement: handed to the execution step; no entry recorded yet` | no ENTRY intent is stored for the approval (the intent reader returned None); with an intent the line is `Placement: already placed (acknowledged by the exchange; fill state is in the journal)` (ACKED), `Placement: needs reconciliation` plus the reconciliation wording (UNKNOWN, SENT, INTENDED) or `Placement: rejected` (REJECTED); an ambiguous result is never shown as rejected (Q5) |
| `EXPIRED at 2026-10-09 10:01:01 +07 (2026-10-09 03:01:01 UTC): no confirmation was taken (CONFIRM_TTL_ELAPSED); nothing was placed` | the sweep at issue + 61 s expires the confirm with the core reason `CONFIRM_TTL_ELAPSED` (the window is inclusive at 60 s) |

The other final texts (`CANCELLED by user ... ; nothing was placed`, `REFUSED at ...: <CODE>; nothing
was placed`) use the same head and are covered by `tests/test_confirm_flow.py`. All times are the
local `+07` time with UTC in brackets (D-14; owner O-3 answered 2026-10-30).
